canonical_capture_law: Every future tide requests all provider-advertised HTTP event fields with time bounds only. Before any event is persisted publicly, literal clientIP is replaced by stable HMAC-SHA256 clientIPIdentity; every other captured provider field remains unchanged.

identity_law.key_custody: GitHub Actions secret CRAWLERBAIT_ID_KEY; never repository bytes
identity_law.rotation_law: A changed key with the same epoch is a continuity error and capture must fail.

public_law: Canonical traffic captures are ordinary public Crawlerbait Traces in this public repository and are linked from /crawlerbait/traffic.json.
bootstrap_law: When the canonical raw cursor is uninitialized, capture begins at the live provider retention boundary and freezes everything still available before advancing incrementally.

legacy_404_evidence.law: Preserve as partial historical 404 evidence only. Never extend it and never mix its counts with canonical whole-web-traffic request counts.
